product.description: Monoprice™CSW-10: 10" 200-Watt Compact SubwooferThe Monoprice™ CSW-10 is an 10" 200W-powered compact subwoofer that's small enough to not dominate the room and still power through with ample bass output. This diminutive ported subwoofer can be placed anywhere in your room without taking up a lot of space—in the corner, beside your sofa or TV stand—and not have it dominate your décor. Hook-up is a breeze through the RCA inputs or high-level speaker inputs—easily set your output with the volume, crossover, and phase controls. You also won't have to skimp on the bass output as the CSW-10 has been specifically engineered to take advantage of its compact enclosure.10" Driver200-Watt AmplifierCompact EnclosureRCA InputsHigh-Level Speaker InputsPhase ControlCrossover Setting COMPACT ENCLOSUREThe small enclosure will bring the bass to any space and not dominate your room décor. 10-INCH DRIVERThe heavy-duty 10-inch driver has been engineered to produce gobs of impactful deep bass in a small, compact enclosure. This ensures you’re hearing and feeling the bass on every music track or your favorite movie. POWERFUL AMPLIFIERThe CSW-10 is outfitted with a 200-watt subwoofer amplifier to deliver fantastic deep-bass performance. Easily accessible, built-in controls for volume, low pass filter, and phase (0/180 degree)—set up the subwoofer for optimum bass-level playback. Set the power toggle to Auto On/Off for fast and easy power switching. EASY HOOK-UPConnect with the stereo line level RCA inputs or through the high-power speaker line level inputs if a preamp or subwoofer output isn’t available. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x CSW-10 10in 200 Watt Compact Subwoofer• 1x User Manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
